desc: rolling sinusoid colour bands, hydra's first word

params.name: freq
params.help: how many bands across the screen — two wide bars up to a fine grating

params.name: sync
params.help: how fast the bands roll sideways; near zero they hang almost still

params.name: offset
params.help: pulls red and blue out of phase — grey bands at 0, full RGB fringing up high

params.name: video
params.help: video shows through in the dark troughs between bands
